result.summary: The intersection features a wide roadway with multiple lanes and minimal pedestrian infrastructure, including a single marked crosswalk but no visible pedestrian signals. The surrounding environment is heavily wooded, which may limit sight lines, and the lack of continuous sidewalks or refuge islands increases risk for people crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated signals for pedestrians are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians to guess when it is safe to cross.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the corners may block visibility between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve safety.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility of pedestrians to oncoming traffic.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide roadway adjacent to a wooded area with a complete absence of pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks or marked crosswalks. Although a traffic signal is present, the environment is highly hostile to pedestrians due to the lack of dedicated walking space and safe crossing facilities.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or paved shoulders, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved, uneven terrain.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Despite the presence of a traffic signal, there are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals to facilitate safe crossing of the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense vegetation and trees along the road edge may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the embankment

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk separated from the roadway to provide a safe and accessible path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian countdown signals at the signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim back trees and undergrowth near the intersection to improve sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a curb ramp with tactile warnings, providing basic accessibility. However, the wide multi-lane crossing lacks a pedestrian refuge island and visible pedestrian signal heads, increasing the risk of exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to shorten the crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals to inform pedestrians of the remaining time to cross safely.

result.summary: The image shows a residential or park-adjacent street with a faded crosswalk and a sidewalk that appears to terminate or transition into a path. There is a lack of pedestrian-specific signage or signals, and the stone wall along the roadway may limit visibility for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image across the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signage
hazards.description: There are no signs warning drivers of the upcoming pedestrian crossing in an area with limited sightlines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness and compliance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Pedestrian Crossing' warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of people crossing, especially given the curve and wall.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Ensure ADA-compliant curb ramps are installed at the crossing points to provide accessibility for all users.
